lines.5: 「And while I was at it, I made your lunch as well.」
lines.7: 「I said it was merely while I was making my own.」
lines.8: 「I laid out your uniform and socks over there.」
lines.10: 「Your handkerchief and tissues are on the table. Change the handkerchief if you dislike the pattern.」
lines.13: ...Otome marched off to school with her back ramrod straight.
lines.14: 「What does she eat to have that much energy?」
lines.16: On closer inspection, my leather shoes had been polished to a shine.
lines.17: She really was energetic from the moment morning began.
